proof:
Source: step 7 of the parent proof (the triple (η(M), θ∘η⁻¹, ξ∘η⁻¹) represents X'); the transport of the representation, including rectifiability, local integrability, measurability and orientation by approximate tangent planes, is the sibling rep_pushforward for the blow-up η_#X, and dilation_blowup identifies X' with η_#X.
Conventions. ℝ^P = Euclid P; η := dilation a λ, η(y) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y = λ⁻¹(y − a), λ > 0. For V ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(V) = TestFormOn V k is the space of C^∞ k-forms ω on ℝ^P (maps to k-covectors) with compact tsupport ω ⊆ V; its elements are determined by their underlying forms. 𝒟_k(V) = GeometricCurrentOn V k. For X, X' ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), X' is a dilation of X when X'(ω) = λ^{−k}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. η_#Y := η_{a,λ#}Y = blowUp Y a λ ∈ 𝒟_k(η(U)) for Y ∈ 𝒟_k(U). Sibling names refer to the children of this decomposition: testform_correspondence = dtc_blowUp_testForm_corr, blowup_structure = dtc_blowUp_algebra, rep_pushforward = dtc_blowUp_imrep, mass_scaling = dtc_blowUp_massOn_image, dilation_blowup = cbr_cidc_dilation_exists_eq_blowUp.
An IMRep in a domain U (contract IMRep U m) is a triple (M, θ, ξ) with M Borel, M ⊆ U, M countably m-rectifiable, θ : ℝ^P → ℕ measurable with θ > 0 on M and ∫_{M∩K} θ dHᵐ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) a.e. strongly measurable for Hᵐ⌞M, and, for Hᵐ⌞M-a.e. y, ξ(y) a unit orientation of some Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m M y Q (Hᵐ = μHE[m]). R.action(φ) = ∫_M θ(y)·ξ(y)(φ(y)) dHᵐ(y) depends only on the triple and on the underlying form φ; R represents T ∈ 𝒟_m(U) iff T(φ) = R.action(φ) for all φ ∈ 𝒟^m(U).
1. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in ℝ^P representing X. By rep_pushforward (U = ℝ^P, n = m, T = X, x = a) there is an IMRep R' = (M', θ', ξ') in η(ℝ^P) that represents η_#X (its measure identity is not needed here).
2. η is onto ℝ^P: for y ∈ ℝ^P, η(a + λy) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹(a + λy) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹a + (λ⁻¹λ)y = y because λ ≠ 0. Hence ℝ^P ⊆ η(ℝ^P), i.e. η(ℝ^P) = ℝ^P, so every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) is also an element of 𝒟^k(η(ℝ^P)) with the same underlying form (tsupport ω ⊆ ℝ^P ⊆ η(ℝ^P); SimonGMT testFormOnInclusion), and every element of 𝒟^k(η(ℝ^P)) is an element of 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with the same underlying form.
3. R'' := (M', θ', ξ') is an IMRep in ℝ^P: M' is Borel and countably m-rectifiable, θ' is measurable and positive on M', ξ' is a.e. strongly measurable for Hᵐ⌞M' and orients approximate tangent planes Hᵐ⌞M'-a.e. — these requirements do not involve the domain and hold because R' is an IMRep. M' ⊆ ℝ^P trivially. Local integrability: if K ⊆ ℝ^P is compact, then K ⊆ η(ℝ^P) by step 2, so ∫_{M'∩K} θ' dHᵐ < ∞ by the local integrability of R' in η(ℝ^P).
4. R'' represents X'. Let ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) and let ω₁ ∈ 𝒟^m(η(ℝ^P)) be ω regarded in η(ℝ^P) (same underlying form). By dilation_blowup (ii), X'(ω) = η_#X(ω₁). Since R' represents η_#X, η_#X(ω₁) = R'.action(ω₁) = ∫_{M'} θ'(y)ξ'(y)(ω₁(y)) dHᵐ(y) = ∫_{M'} θ'(y)ξ'(y)(ω(y)) dHᵐ(y) = R''.action(ω). Hence X'(ω) = R''.action(ω) for all ω.
5. Therefore X' = τ(M', θ', ξ') with R'' an IMRep in ℝ^P, i.e. X' is integer multiplicity. No hypothesis on m was used. ∎
Formalization notes (proved in a scratch build from the exact sibling types): obtain ⟨R', hR', -⟩ := rep_pushforward P m univ X a λ hlam R hR; build ⟨R'.carrier, R'.mult, R'.orient, R'.measurableSet_carrier, subset_univ _, R'.rectifiable, R'.measurable_mult, R'.mult_pos, fun K hK _ => R'.locallyIntegrable_mult K hK (fun y _ => hsurj (mem_univ y)), R'.aestronglyMeasurable_orient, R'.orients⟩ (anonymous constructor); then rw [(dilation_blowup P m a λ hlam).2 X X' hX ω (testFormOnInclusion hsurj m ω) rfl, hR'] and close by rfl.
